classifications.rationale: FocusTrace's text contrast engine measures the same rendered color evidence but applies AA thresholds, not the enhanced AAA ratios.
FocusTrace reviews repeated-function identification across pages and ambiguous link purpose in context, but it does not yet implement axe's same-accessible-name/same-purpose comparison exactly.
FocusTrace does not currently inspect meta refresh, including the stricter AAA no-exceptions variant.
